summary: Iter 383 FULL-SYSTEM audit per E1 review request. BACKEND 55/55 pass (~9s) — auth, dashboard KPIs, bookings create/list, ALL NEW endpoints (predictive HK forecast+generate+suggest-shifts w/ dedupe, hurdle-LRV forecast+config w/ 422 validation, AI-pricing LRV guardrail clamping suggested_rate=30 → floor >30, segment forecast /forecast-v2/segments/all + property variant), plus 35-endpoint smoke sweep covering revenue/HK/CRM/finance/CM/marketing/admin — ZERO 5xx errors. FRONTEND: login OK; sidebar groups expand; ALL new UI panels present and populated — hk-hub-tab-predictive → predictive-hk-panel with 8 day cards + gen-btn + suggest-shifts-btn; hurdle-lrv-panel with hurdle-table + hurdle-min-rate-input + hurdle-save-config-btn; forecast-v2 Segmentler tab with fcv2-segments-table rendering direct/OTA/diğer columns and history+forecast rows. Public booking widget /book/aldgate-flats renders full page with hero, dates, CHECK AVAILABILITY CTA. No global ErrorBoundary triggered anywhere.
action_items: Nice-to-have: /checkin/{property_slug} returns near-empty body (~137 chars) when hit without a booking token — expected behavior since guest self-check-in needs a token in URL, but a friendly 'invalid/expired link' state would be better UX. Low priority.

Sanity: E1 review request wrote `GET /api/forecast-v2/segments/all?months=6` — the route is `/forecast-v2/segments/{property_id}` and accepts `all` as a literal value; that works fine. No action needed, just noting for future clarity.

Predictive HK suggest-shifts requires housekeeper users in DB. On aldgate-flats it worked (housekeepers exist). If a property has no housekeepers, endpoint returns 400 with clear Turkish message — good behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: LRV guardrail integration is clean: /api/revenue/ai-pricing/{pid}/accept + run-auto-apply + _internal_auto_apply all lazy-import compute_lrv_floor and clamp before writing rate_overrides. Response includes lrv_clamped counter — verified >=1 in test with suggested_rate=30 vs computed floor ~136. Rationale is annotated with '· LRV guardrail: fiyat £X tabanına yükseltildi'.
Predictive HK is idempotent by design (dup check on property_id+due_date+room_number+task_subtype+auto_generated). suggest-shifts also idempotent per (property, date, staff_id, role).
Hurdle config validates min_rate >= 0 and 0 <= overbooking_cap <= 20 with 422 — verified via invalid cap=999 test.
Segment forecast endpoint correctly returns 12-month history bounded by current month and N forecast months; graceful fallback when a segment has no LY data (uses segment monthly avg).
